strengths.point: Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Institutional money has been flowing out.
weaknesses.evidence: NEGATIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change -1.82 pp

weaknesses.point: Foreign institutions have been cutting their stake.
Domestic institutions have been cutting their stake.

opportunities.point: The company is looking at a business trajectory of over 150 crores for FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, right now, we are at a trajectory of INR 150 crores plus business is what we are looking at." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management estimates a PAT of around 25 crores for FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We are estimating a PAT of around INR 25 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company acquired advanced notebook manufacturing machinery for in-house production through the acquisition of a Linomatic Flexo print notebook manufacturing machine.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Acquisition of Linomatic Flexo print notebook manufacturing machine" (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The company expanded full-fledged operations into Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Assam.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Commenced full-fledged operations in Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, & Assam." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the company has begun FY27 with encouraging momentum across its publishing and integrated education businesses.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We have begun FY27 with encouraging momentum across our publishing and integrated education businesses." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The education sector continues to experience steady demand, particularly in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets, which is supported by curriculum expansion and institutional requirements.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The education sector continues to witness steady demand, particularly across Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets, supported by curriculum expansion and institutional requirements." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company reported an installed printing capacity of 15 tonnes per day with current utilization at approximately 75% of installed capacity.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Current utilization at ~75% of installed capacity" (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The company supplies textbooks to around 10,000 schools across 15 states in India.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "we are currently supplying textbooks to schools across three different boards, that is CBSE, ICSE and State board to around 10,000 schools in 15 states in India." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The in-house notebook manufacturing will become fully operational in the next 30 days.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "In the next one month. In the next 30 days." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company aims to get into all 28 states and 8 union territories of the country in the next 3 years.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, in the next 3 years, my target is to get into all the 28 states and 8 union territories of the country." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 3 years]

opportunities.point: The company targets to do more than 500 crores of turnover in the next five to six years.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, my target is in the next five to six years, I should be able to do more than INR 500 crores of turnover with a mixture of all these products, textbooks, uniform, stationery and notebook." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company will not be declaring a dividend this year as it is a growing company.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "Right now, we are a growing company. Maybe we will probably declare next year after once we reach a certain target which are there in our mind. But this year, no dividend." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -4.46 pp, DII -7.6 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S2/W8/O27/T4), led by 'The company is looking at a business trajectory of over 150 crores for FY27', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
